mechanism.base: Earth is what the fire leaves behind. Wood burns down to ash and ash is already soil, so every blaze ends as ground that something else can stand on. The flame spends itself and the field keeps the gift, dark and warm and ready for seed. What began as light becomes a place, and the place outlasts the fire that made it.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Earth, the light has no ground to land on. What you make stays heat and never becomes something a person can hold. Finish one small thing and give it away.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Earth, the ground piles up and dims the fire. So much gets made that the light goes dull under its own harvest. Make nothing for a week and take something in.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Earth makes it slow and solid, made to last. As a catalyst, the gate sticks, and you give quietly rather than show what you can do. You pay in kindness not given and talent not shown.
function.definition_friction: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. What you give, Earth settles into a shape that holds. As a friction, the gate never shuts, so you keep giving or keep proving instead of taking in. You run empty on comfort given and points already won.
function.advise_catalyst: What you keep inside does not count as finished. Make one thing a week that someone else can hold. Say the opinion you have been sitting on to one person. Show a child or a friend something you know how to do. Write one line down before bed.
function.advise_friction: Seek Wood, the Mind energy. Wood is the slow growing, roots holding ground and leaf fed by rain, something in you before anything comes out. Let it hold what Earth pours. You do not have to turn every warm feeling into something given. Read one chapter ahead of giving an opinion. Keep one evening a week for reading.

candidates.cta_verdict: You show what you feel by making something solid rather than saying it, and what you build tends to outlast the moment.

catalyst.clause: The light has no ground to land on.
catalyst.remedy: Finish one small thing and give it away.

friction.clause: The ground piles up and dims the fire.
friction.remedy: Make nothing for a week and take something in.

wide.clause: You have plenty of Earth, the ground your fire was always meant to warm.
wide.remedy: Build on it. Finish something that outlasts the week.

missing.clause: The fire finds nothing to warm into shape, so what you feel stays feeling.
missing.remedy: Take Earth on loan. Make one plain thing and hand it over.

spared.clause: No Earth drawing on the fire, so the light keeps its warmth for itself.
spared.remedy: Leave it. Spend your warmth where it feeds you.

thin.clause: Only a little Earth on the fire, enough to make something without dimming the light.
thin.remedy: Keep it small. One made thing at a time.

excess.clause: So much Earth that the fire can hardly be seen, a light buried under what it made.
excess.remedy: Clear the ash. Make less and rest more.

__ore.retired_bonds_dip: People inhabit what you express: your warmth reaches them as belonging.
__ore.retired_fn_body: The Voice is your expression function: the gate where inner heat becomes outer fact. With Earth running it, expression in you builds rather than dazzles: lessons, systems, homes, traditions warm to the touch. You speak in things that outlast the saying. Feed it steadily and your warmth becomes infrastructure, the kind of expression people live inside for years.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Fire, and Fire feeds Earth: ash becomes soil. Whatever your heat pours itself into becomes your Expression, the channel where your burning turns to ground others stand on. Every lesson taught, every custom kept warm, every gathering hosted is your flame settling into something lasting. Light shows. Soil stays.

backlog_dips_tg_pattern.mind: Teaching is how your thinking settles: explain it once and you own it.

__ore.retired_v3_definition_catalyst:
Earth is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is your heat becoming things that last: lessons taught, systems written down, gatherings that become traditions. You are at your best converting enthusiasm into something others can stand on.

The recipe people ask for, the onboarding doc that outlived your job, the Friday dinner that somehow became an institution among your friends: that is this energy working. Your excitement keeps turning into furniture other lives get to use.

Enthusiasm fades, structure remembers. After every burst of inspiration, spend one hour making it hold: a document, a recipe, a repeatable plan. Host the gathering twice and it becomes tradition. Write down the thing you keep explaining.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_friction:
Earth is your Expression, and as a friction, it is making monuments out of moments: every idea formalized, every project turned permanent, output hardening while your energy thins.

Every hobby has a spreadsheet, every dinner a theme, every passing thought a folder. The instinct to make things last has started embalming them instead, and maintaining past enthusiasms now crowds out having new ones.

Some warmth is meant to be spent, never stored. Let the next good idea stay a conversation. Retire one system you maintain out of habit. Pour your building energy into the single structure that actually matters this year, and let the rest be evenings.
